q: When a charge is given to a conducting object of any shape, the charge is found to be spread out over the outer surface of the object.
e: True. When a charge is given to a conducting object of any shape, the charge is found to be spread out over the outer surface of the object. Coulomb's law is K Q1 Q2 / r² along the line joining the charges.
